x-card.label: X Summary Large Image card
x-card.notes: Use for X link cards and illustrated feature cards.

x-feed.label: X feed post (landscape)
x-feed.notes: Practical wide-post default for organic X feed visuals when you want a broader editorial composition than X cards.
x-feed.source: brand-gen practical feed preset for X organic posts

x-feed-square.label: X feed post (square)
x-feed-square.notes: Use when one square asset should work across multiple social feeds.

x-feed-portrait.label: X feed post (portrait)
x-feed-portrait.notes: Use for taller organic X feed visuals that maximize mobile vertical space.

linkedin-card.label: LinkedIn custom image / link card
linkedin-card.notes: Best-fit default for LinkedIn link/share cards.

linkedin-feed.label: LinkedIn feed post (landscape)
linkedin-feed.notes: Safe landscape preset for LinkedIn feed posts and product announcements.
linkedin-feed.source: LinkedIn Marketing Solutions single image specs

linkedin-feed-square.label: LinkedIn feed post (square)
linkedin-feed-square.notes: Use for cleaner feed posts where centered composition matters more than wide framing.
linkedin-feed-square.source: LinkedIn Marketing Solutions single image specs

linkedin-feed-portrait.label: LinkedIn feed post (portrait)
linkedin-feed-portrait.notes: Portrait preset aligned to LinkedIn's supported vertical single-image format.
linkedin-feed-portrait.source: LinkedIn Marketing Solutions single image specs

og-card.label: Generic Open Graph social card
og-card.notes: Common cross-platform OG default inferred from major social preview ecosystems.
og-card.source: brand-gen inference from major social preview ecosystems

concept-illustration.label: [DEPRECATED] Concept illustration (umbrella)
concept-illustration.notes: Deprecated umbrella type. Prefer system-explainer-illustration for mechanism-led SaaS explanation, or editorial-metaphor-illustration for essay/metaphor-led work. Deprecated umbrella type. Prefer system-explainer-illustration or editorial-metaphor-illustration for new planning. Abstract branded illustration that explains a concept, value, or idea without showing product UI. Uses brand palette, motifs, and illustration style to create a visual metaphor. Think editorial illustration, not screenshot.

brand-scene.label: [DEPRECATED] Brand scene (umbrella)
brand-scene.notes: Deprecated umbrella type. Prefer illustrated-brand-world only when explicit illustrated worldbuilding is desired. Deprecated umbrella type. Prefer illustrated-brand-world only when explicit worldbuilding is desired. Atmospheric brand-world imagery — landscapes, environments, or abstract scenes that establish mood and brand feeling. No UI elements. Think backgrounds, headers, or immersive brand moments.

data-card.label: Data visualization card
data-card.notes: One big number or stat + context sentence on branded field. Bold display font for the number, body font for context. Brand mark bottom-left. Think 'stat of the day' social card.

quote-card.label: Quote / testimonial card
quote-card.notes: Customer quote or team quote on branded background. Large quotation marks or italic display font for the quote, attribution below. Brand mark anchored. Clean, editorial feel.

announcement-card.label: Announcement / launch card
announcement-card.notes: Bold headline announcing a launch, feature, or milestone. Optional branded illustration or icon supporting the headline. Brand mark + CTA. High energy but brand-disciplined.

process-card.label: How-it-works / process card
process-card.notes: Numbered steps (3-5) showing a process or how-it-works flow. Each step gets a number + short label. Optional small branded icons per step. Clean whitespace between steps.

content-card.label: Branded content card (portrait)
content-card.notes: Text-heavy branded card for Instagram/LinkedIn carousels. Headline + body text + optional photo inset + brand mark. Keep text at 24pt+ for mobile readability, 250px safe zone from top/bottom edges.

content-card-square.label: Branded content card (square)
content-card-square.notes: Square content card for multi-platform carousels and social feeds. Same text-heavy structure as portrait variant.

state-card.label: Truth-first product state card
state-card.notes: Shareable square card built around one real app state, prompt detail, skill page, or feed crop. Preserve screenshot truth and add brand treatment around it rather than redrawing the UI.

carousel-slide.label: Carousel slide (portrait)
carousel-slide.notes: Sequential carousel slide — designed as part of a swipeable series. Numbered if part of a how-to or list. Slide 1 = hook, final slide = CTA.

editorial-card.label: Editorial / blog article card
editorial-card.notes: Long-form branded editorial card with large serif/display headline, body paragraph, CTA link, and brand mark. Inspired by Tia Health blog cards.

info-card.label: Informational card with bullet list
info-card.notes: Branded card with headline, subhead, body text, and bullet list. Optional rounded photo inset in corner. Educational/explainer format.

podcast-cover.label: Podcast cover art
podcast-cover.notes: Square podcast artwork aligned to Apple Podcasts and Spotify guidance. Keep the show title large and legible at thumbnail size.
podcast-cover.source: Apple Podcasts Marketing Tools + Spotify for Creators

podcast-banner.label: Podcast episode / YouTube promo banner
podcast-banner.notes: Landscape episode-promo surface aligned to YouTube thumbnail guidance. Keep the title hierarchy bold and safe inside a 16:9 crop.

terminal-hero.label: Terminal hero still
terminal-hero.notes: Wide landscape crop around one real CLI moment. Preserve monospace clarity at docs-hero scale.

cli-recording.label: CLI recording frame
cli-recording.notes: Landscape still framed around one frame of an authentic CLI recording.

command-illustration.label: Command illustration
command-illustration.notes: Portrait feature-illustration crop pairing a real command with a restrained branded diagram.

system-explainer-illustration.label: System explainer illustration
system-explainer-illustration.notes: Structured concept still that makes one product or protocol mechanic legible at a glance. Prefer visible flow and one clear causal system over ambient worldbuilding.

editorial-metaphor-illustration.label: Editorial metaphor illustration
editorial-metaphor-illustration.notes: Single-metaphor editorial illustration for essays, launch narratives, or thought pieces. Use one clear visual metaphor tied to brand vocabulary, not a collage of symbols.

illustrated-brand-world.label: Illustrated brand world
illustrated-brand-world.notes: Narrative worldbuilding still used only when an atmospheric illustrated environment is explicitly desired. Must still imply process, not just mood.

proof-poster.label: Proof poster / operator board
proof-poster.notes: Default landscape proof board for operator workflow, skill share, and capability proof. Use portrait only by explicit override for quote/stat-led posters; exact labels and QR/footer copy should be deterministic HTML/SVG/composite.
proof-poster.source: brand-gen proof-poster landscape operator board contract v2

site-pattern-tile.label: Site pattern tile
site-pattern-tile.notes: Single deployable pattern tile meant to sit behind UI or sections on a live site. Low contrast, repeatable, and restraint-first.

pattern-board.label: Pattern board
pattern-board.notes: Exploration board showing a few coherent pattern applications within one grammar. Use for internal review, not as the default site-output target.

landing-hero.label: Landing hero background animation
landing-hero.notes: Short muted hero visual plate placed beside or behind separate one-line title/body copy. Generate no nav, headline, CTA, footer, or full webpage chrome inside the asset. Export primary MP4; optionally transcode WebM for web delivery.
landing-hero.source: brand-gen web hero animation preset informed by MDN/video autoplay and reduced-motion guidance

website-hero-illustration.label: Website hero sidecar illustration
website-hero-illustration.notes: Static sidecar art that sits next to external hero copy. No headline, nav, CTA, or full-page layout inside the image.

lifestyle_mockup.product_truth_expression: one approved branded asset or screen carried into a realistic scene or hand-held context

website_hero_illustration.target_surface: product landing page hero, marketing website above-the-fold, or homepage hero section
website_hero_illustration.purpose: produce a branded editorial illustration that anchors a website hero section with strong product-truth and clear meaning at glance
website_hero_illustration.product_truth_expression: one approved branded concept, product moment, or system mechanic rendered as a flat editorial illustration suitable for a website hero slot

campaign_poster.target_surface: poster, launch board, or event announcement

campaign_poster.product_truth_expression: a concrete brand phrase, mark, or product concept that ladders back to the core value proposition

pattern_system.product_truth_expression: the system behavior of the brand mark and brand memory, not a random abstract pattern

sticker_family.target_surface: community assets, packaging, event handouts, or social extras
sticker_family.purpose: extend the mark into a coherent family of branded units
sticker_family.product_truth_expression: the mark anatomy and brand system logic behind the product

merch_poster.target_surface: print, event, merch, or campaign collateral
merch_poster.purpose: create a collectible branded surface without becoming generic poster art
merch_poster.product_truth_expression: a concrete brand theme, phrase, or motif tied to the actual product identity

brand_bumper.target_surface: video intro or mark-preserving identity sting only

brand_bumper.product_truth_expression: the actual brand mark and one concrete motion attitude; not for feature/capability animations

styleframe.target_surface: pitch deck, brand guidelines, or launch page hero
styleframe.purpose: show what the real product looks like inside the brand system — the nav, layout, and chrome must match the actual product

terminal_hero.target_surface: docs hero, launch page, or social launch card
terminal_hero.purpose: package one real terminal moment inside a brand-disciplined frame without fictionalizing the shell
terminal_hero.product_truth_expression: a real CLI prompt, command, and output captured from the actual recording or session

cli_recording.target_surface: docs, social launch, or changelog preview
cli_recording.purpose: frame one authentic recording frame with brand carrier and palette without editing the terminal content
cli_recording.product_truth_expression: one verbatim frame from an actual CLI recording or demo session

command_illustration.target_surface: docs section, feature page, or launch carousel
command_illustration.purpose: teach what a specific command does by pairing the real command with a restrained branded diagram
command_illustration.product_truth_expression: one real command with verbatim flags and output, plus one illustrative annotation

system_explainer_illustration.target_surface: editorial explainer, docs still, or launch narrative card
system_explainer_illustration.purpose: make one concrete system, workflow, or protocol mechanic visually legible without collapsing into generic AI brand art
system_explainer_illustration.product_truth_expression: one specific product or protocol mechanic with visible flow, causality, or structure

editorial_metaphor_illustration.target_surface: essay illustration, launch narrative, or thought-leadership card
editorial_metaphor_illustration.purpose: carry one clear brand-tied metaphor with editorial clarity instead of a broad scene or multi-symbol collage
editorial_metaphor_illustration.product_truth_expression: one explicit brand metaphor tied to the product philosophy or vocabulary

illustrated_brand_world.target_surface: launch film styleframe, immersive header, or occasional editorial world moment
illustrated_brand_world.purpose: establish an illustrated brand environment only when explicit worldbuilding is useful
illustrated_brand_world.product_truth_expression: the brand's work should still feel implied by the environment, tools, or activity

proof_poster.target_surface: launch still, campaign board, or proof-heavy social poster
proof_poster.purpose: lead with a quote, screenshot, stat, or proof payload while keeping the brand mark subordinate to the message hierarchy
proof_poster.product_truth_expression: one real screenshot, quote, stat, or other proof payload that visibly carries the piece

site_pattern_tile.target_surface: website backgrounds, section underlays, and subtle surface support
site_pattern_tile.purpose: create one reusable low-contrast pattern tile that works on a real site instead of a presentation board
site_pattern_tile.product_truth_expression: repeatable mark-derived system logic suitable for web deployment

pattern_board.target_surface: internal design review or system presentation
pattern_board.purpose: show a few related pattern applications inside one coherent grammar
pattern_board.product_truth_expression: one repeat grammar expanded into a small exploratory board, not unrelated motifs

how one system appears across materials

product_core.description: Default product-led set for software brands that need clear product understanding before abstract identity play.

launch_core.description: Launch-ready set with one hero, one feature visual, one social output, one motion asset, and one support system.

brand_system_core.description: System-first set for brands that already have strong product proof and want applied identity extensions.

social_launch.description: Social-first set tuned for launch cadence and repeated branded outputs across feeds.

brand-scene.note: Deprecated umbrella scene type. Prefer illustrated-brand-world only when explicit brand-world worldbuilding is desired.

campaign-poster.note: Deprecated poster type. Prefer proof-poster so hierarchy is led by quote, screenshot, stat, or other proof payload instead of a dominant logo.

pattern-system.note: Deprecated pattern umbrella. Planning now defaults to one deployable site-pattern-tile; use pattern-board only for exploration boards.

concept-illustration.note: Deprecated illustration umbrella. Planning now defaults to system-explainer-illustration unless the brief is explicitly metaphor-led.

bumper-animation.note: Deprecated generic bumper/sting. Prefer a purposeful feature-animation, the landing-hero background animation for above-the-fold motion, or logo-animation only when the explicit job is mark-preserving logo motion.
